title: dreams last night
content: Last night I visited many places in my “dream town.” I have not been to the mall recently. Last night it was my dream version on TJ Maxx and Target, and also driving on some roads that I frequent a lot. In my dreams these roads are in the town I live in but they’re not there in real life, but I always end up on the same ones. In the TJ Maxx I was in the cosmetic section and all the bottles were opened up and almost empty. A girl I work with was there and she was going on about how terrible the selection was even though she had a basket full of things. The Target was different this time. Usually the Target is outdated but this time it was like it had been updated. There was a huge, fancy jewelry store in the middle. I also found my way into a huge section of seasonal type items that I’ve never been to before. I went to the grocery section but couldn’t remember what I needed there so I went to check out. I went to put my items on the conveyor but the lady at the register insisted I give her my basket and somehow everything was scanned all at once. When I went to pay, she requested my ID even though I didn’t buy any alcohol and she then told me my ID was too old. I was too frustrated at this point and that’s when I woke up.
